caption_L1: This is a line graph called Number of infant deaths in the United Kingdom from 2000 to 2018 (in 1,000s). The x-axis measures Year while the y-axis shows Infant mortality rate.
caption_L2L3: Infant deaths in the UK have been declining since 2010. There was a slight increase in infant deaths around 2001-2002 and then it stayed fairly steady from 2002-2008 until deaths began to decline.
